Second probe added to your WorldScene, same shape as deepCurrentAtScreen: __ml.lightsInView(pad = 96) — every EmissiveSource whose drawn anchor lands in a padded worldView, from BOTH this.emissiveSources and this.sceneryLightSources, as {id, x, y, r, color, sealed}. Two fields added to EmissiveSource in your WorldScene, both additive and neither read by the lighting: hx/hy, the DRAWN position of a source's glowing centroid, unclamped.
